title: KidZania Dallas Day Pass
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Experience KidZania, the ultimate interactive edutainment park where kids can become firefighters, fly a real Boeing-737 flight simulator, investigate crime scenes, and perform live on stage.

This ultra-realistic indoor city features paved streets, authentic tools, and fully immersive role-playing activities for children of all ages.

Plus, KidZania teaches essential financial literacy for kids using kidZos currency and bank cards, empowering young minds to independently manage, save, or spend their earnings during their visit.
